posts.title: Gemini 4 Neon, Measured: My Test Broke Before Any Model Did
posts.description: Gemini 4 Neon against Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.2 Astra on my own code: 155 runs, five of eight tasks dropped out. What holds: cost and speed, not a ranking.

posts.title: The lead session takes the night shift
posts.description: One lead session coordinates my parallel coding sessions with leases, constraints and a merge order. Open questions reach me in one queue. Now on npm, MIT.

posts.title: Logging in again was wrong: a morning with a provider outage
posts.description: Two of my coding sessions got the same error: log in again. The status page said something else. Seven rules from a provider outage that lasted two hours.
